# Tembo MCP API Reference

<!-- Generated by npm run update:openapi. Do not edit manually. -->

This reference contains all 125 public API operations available through Tembo MCP. It is generated from the same versioned OpenAPI schema as the MCP tool catalog.

In compact mode, use `search_tools` and `get_tool_schema` to discover these operations, then call them with `call_read_tool` or `call_write_tool`.

| Method | Path | MCP operation | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/agent` | `post-public-api-agent` | Create an agent. For new integrations, use POST /v1/agents. |
| POST | `/agent/{keyOrId}/trigger` | `post-public-api-agent-by-key-or-id-trigger` | Queue an agent run. For new integrations, use POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/runs. |
| GET | `/me` | `get-public-api-me` | Retrieve the organization and user IDs associated with the current request. |
| GET | `/repository/list` | `get-public-api-repository-list` | List enabled repositories for the organization. For new integrations, use GET /v1/repositories. |
| POST | `/session/{sessionId}/messages` | `create-session-message-compatibility` | Create and deliver a session message. For new integrations, use POST /v1/messages. |
| POST | `/session/{sessionId}/stop` | `stop-session-compatibility` | Stop active session work. For new integrations, use POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/stop. |
| POST | `/session/create` | `create-session-compatibility` | Create a session. For new integrations, use POST /v1/sessions. |
| GET | `/session/list` | `list-sessions-compatibility` | List sessions. For new integrations, use GET /v1/sessions. |
| GET | `/session/search` | `search-sessions-compatibility` | Search sessions. For new integrations, use the filters on GET /v1/sessions. |
| GET | `/v1/agents` | `list-agents` | List agents available in your organization, with optional search, status, integration, and author filters. |
| POST | `/v1/agents` | `create-agent` | Create an agent from instructions, a template, or another agent. sourceAgentId cannot be combined with other fields. Template creation accepts only templateName, name, and triggers; creation from scratch requires name. |
| DELETE | `/v1/agents/{agentId}` | `delete-agent` | Delete an agent and its scheduled and triggered jobs. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/{agentId}` | `retrieve-agent` | Retrieve an agent and its configuration, repository associations, and run summary. |
| PATCH | `/v1/agents/{agentId}` | `update-agent` | Update agent configuration. Supply expectedUpdatedAt to reject an update if the agent changed since it was retrieved. Enabling or archiving an agent also updates its schedules and triggers. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/runs` | `list-agent-runs` | List executions of an agent, including status, linked session, measured duration, and failure summary. |
| POST | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/runs` | `create-agent-run` | Queue an agent run with optional event input. The response confirms queuing, not completed execution. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/runs/{runId}` | `retrieve-agent-run` | Retrieve the status, linked session, measured duration, and failure summary of an agent run. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/schedules` | `list-agent-schedules` | List the schedules configured for an agent. |
| POST | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/schedules` | `create-agent-schedule` | Create a recurring schedule that starts agent runs using a cron expression. |
| DELETE | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/schedules/{scheduleId}` | `delete-agent-schedule` | Delete a recurring agent schedule. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/schedules/{scheduleId}` | `retrieve-agent-schedule` | Retrieve an agent schedule, including its enabled state and next execution time. |
| PATCH | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/schedules/{scheduleId}` | `update-agent-schedule` | Update an agent schedule, including its cron expression or enabled state. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/triggers` | `list-agent-triggers` | List the integration events configured to start runs of an agent. |
| POST | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/triggers` | `create-agent-trigger` | Configure an integration event to start agent runs. Available filters depend on the integration and event name. |
| DELETE | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/triggers/{triggerId}` | `delete-agent-trigger` | Delete an integration event trigger for an agent. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/triggers/{triggerId}` | `retrieve-agent-trigger` | Retrieve an agent trigger and its integration event filters. |
| PATCH | `/v1/agents/{agentId}/triggers/{triggerId}` | `update-agent-trigger` | Update an agent trigger configuration or enabled state. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/templates` | `list-agent-templates` | List reusable agent templates and their configuration requirements. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/templates/{templateName}` | `retrieve-agent-template` | Retrieve a reusable agent template by name, including its instructions and required parameters. |
| GET | `/v1/api-keys` | `list-api-keys` | List active API keys for the current organization. |
| POST | `/v1/api-keys` | `create-api-key` | Create an API key for the current organization. The complete token is returned only by this operation. |
| DELETE | `/v1/api-keys/{apiKeyId}` | `delete-api-key` | Revoke an active API key so it can no longer authenticate requests. |
| GET | `/v1/api-keys/{apiKeyId}` | `retrieve-api-key` | Retrieve an active API key without exposing its complete token. |
| PATCH | `/v1/api-keys/{apiKeyId}` | `update-api-key` | Rename an active API key. |

| DELETE | `/v1/artifacts/{artifactId}` | `delete-artifact` | Delete an organization artifact and its backing asset when present. |
| GET | `/v1/artifacts/{artifactId}` | `retrieve-artifact` | Retrieve an organization artifact by ID. |

| GET | `/v1/billing/usage` | `list-billing-usage` | List session usage with cursor pagination. |
| GET | `/v1/insights` | `retrieve-insight` | Retrieve pull request contribution insights and their collection status for the current organization. |
| PATCH | `/v1/insights` | `update-insight` | Enable or disable pull request insight collection. Enabling starts the initial refresh when needed. |
| GET | `/v1/insights/members` | `list-insight-members` | List organization members included in pull request insights. |
| GET | `/v1/insights/repositories` | `list-insight-repositories` | List repositories included in pull request insights for the current organization. |
| GET | `/v1/integrations` | `list-integrations` | List integrations for the authenticated organization. |
| GET | `/v1/integrations/{integrationId}` | `retrieve-integration` | Retrieve an integration for the authenticated organization. |
| GET | `/v1/mcp-connections` | `list-mcp-connections` | List MCP connections for the current organization with cursor pagination and optional search by name or URL. Command arguments, headers, and environment configuration are omitted. |
| POST | `/v1/mcp-connections` | `create-mcp-connection` | Create a new stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP connection. Remote connections support OAuth, client credentials, or static headers and begin authorization when required; stdio commands are stored but never executed by this API. |
| DELETE | `/v1/mcp-connections/{mcpConnectionId}` | `delete-mcp-connection` | Delete an MCP connection from the current organization. |
| GET | `/v1/mcp-connections/{mcpConnectionId}` | `retrieve-mcp-connection` | Retrieve MCP connection configuration and authentication details. Stored header values, environment values, OAuth tokens, and client secrets are never returned. |
| PATCH | `/v1/mcp-connections/{mcpConnectionId}` | `update-mcp-connection` | Update MCP configuration. Header and environment objects merge write-only values by key, null values remove individual keys, and a null environment clears all variables. Hidden credentials are preserved unless explicitly changed or authentication is replaced; changing a remote server URL clears credentials for the old server. Call authorize explicitly after changing the server or authentication to reconnect. |
| POST | `/v1/mcp-connections/{mcpConnectionId}/authorize` | `authorize-mcp-connection` | Connect or authorize a remote Streamable HTTP MCP connection, returning an OAuth URL when user authorization is required. Stdio connections are rejected because this action cannot authorize them. |
| POST | `/v1/mcp-connections/{mcpConnectionId}/test` | `test-mcp-connection` | Test a remote MCP connection by connecting to its server. Stdio connections are rejected because the API does not execute arbitrary local commands. |

| GET | `/v1/messages/{messageId}` | `retrieve-message` | Retrieve an organization message by ID. |
